name: Summer Clay Camps
description_short: Week long clay camps at The Clay Studio's building in South Kensington for youth entering grades 1 to 12, in small classes led by teaching artists: sculpture, wheel throwing and claymation, with some weeks of drawing and mixed media. Half day morning or afternoon camps can be paired for a full day, and Fridays end with a show of the week's work.

fees.name: Supervised lunch (12 to 1 PM, half day campers)
fees.note: Free for campers in both a morning and an afternoon camp; food not included.

refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least 7 days before camp for a full refund less a $25 processing fee; no refunds within 7 days or for missed days. The first switch to another camp is free. A $100 non-refundable deposit holds a spot if not paying in full.
notes: Morning camps 9 to 12, afternoon camps 1 to 4; full day Claymation camps 9 to 4 for grades 1 to 8 in two weeks of the summer. Teen camps are half days. Tuition assistance available to anyone who needs it, no documents required. Camp prices are listed on the registration page, which shows no camps right now (the 2026 list is closed and 2027 is not posted).
